result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major layout problem where the bottom navigation is obscured by a misplaced black bar.

issues.description: A thick black horizontal bar overlays the center of the bottom navigation bar, obscuring the search and saved/orders icons and making them difficult to see and tap.
issues.suggestion: Fix the safe-area/home-indicator positioning so the bar sits below the navigation or is removed, and ensure all bottom navigation icons are fully visible and tappable.
